_about: Rebound game data. Every number and every sentence the player reads lives in this file.
Safe to edit: any number, any text, any color. Keep the punctuation of the file intact: quotes, commas, brackets.
Text style: lead with the effect, write fragments, name the trigger first (On hit:, On bounce:, Every 3 hits:), capitalise keywords (Power, Mult, Crit, Poison, Burn, Armor, Spin, Reach, Speed).

Text can contain placeholders in curly braces, like {power}. They are filled in from the 'values' next to that text, so the sentence always matches the number. Change the number in 'values', not in the sentence.
Do not rename the short ids on the left (like 'whet' or 'slasher'). The game code looks things up by those ids. Rename the 'name' field instead.
You can delete a whole augment, enemy or boss to remove it from the game. Adding a new enemy or boss works from this file alone. Adding a new augment or trophy also needs code.
Keys that start with an underscore are notes for humans and are ignored by the game.

rules._note: Distances are in arena units (the arena is 'arena.size' units wide). Speeds are units per second. Spin is radians per second (6.28 is one full turn a second).

knockback._note: Max HP resists knockback, for enemies and your ball alike. Push x (1 + referenceHp/resistHp) / (1 + hp/resistHp): a ball at the reference HP is pushed normally, more HP is pushed less. Enemy HP is compared before tier scaling, so a Brute always resists more than a Grunt.

scaling._note: Each tier multiplies enemy stats by these numbers. 1.47 means +47% per tier. bossHpFactor scales every boss's listed hp.
scaling._endlessNote: Endless mode, after the final boss: each endless tier multiplies enemy HP (bosses too) by endlessHpPerTier and enemy damage by endlessDamagePerTier, on top of the usual growth above. That extra multiplier itself gets endlessAcceleration (0.1 = 10%) bigger every tier, so difficulty climbs faster and faster.
scaling._lateNote: Late-game push: from tier lateFromTier on, every tier multiplies enemy and boss HP by lateHpPerTier (and damage by lateDamagePerTier, optional) once more, on top of the growth above. firstBossHpPercent (optional) scales only the tier 1 boss.

overflow._note: Stats past their caps (Speed, Spin, blades) are tracked instead of thrown away. Each number here is the +Mult every hit gets for each 100% the stat is over its cap: 0 means off. Effects can also read the overflow directly.

combat._burnNote: Burn ticks deal burnDamagePerStackPerSecond plus burnPowerPercentPerStack % of your current Power, per stack per second, so Burn keeps up late in a run.

elites._note: From fromTier on, a normal fight has chancePercent to give one enemy (not a Swarmling) a modifier, shown on the fight preview: Armored (+armor Armor), Swift (+swiftPercent% Speed), Vampiric (heals vampiricPercent% of damage it deals), Volatile (explodes on death), Warded (immune to Poison, Burn, Chill, Freeze and Shock for wardSeconds). Beating a fight with an elite pays gold.

consumables._note: Items: bagSize is how many you can hold, shopItems how many the shop offers.

bow._note: Your Bow: its fire rate scales with Spin (at its listed Spin it fires every fireEvery seconds), arrow speed with Reach (at its listed Reach, projectiles.playerSpeed). spinPower softens the fire rate: 1 = twice the Spin fires twice as fast, 0.7 = about 1.6 times as fast. Limits below.

status._note: Chill: each stack slows an enemy's movement and blades by chillSlowPercent and fades by chillFadePerSecond. At chillMax stacks the enemy is Frozen (cannot move, swing, shoot or ram) for freezeSeconds; bosses for bossFreezePercent of that.
status._shockNote: Shock: every hit from a shock augment (and Shock damage) adds 1 stack. Each stack cuts the damage that enemy deals by shockPercent, up to shockMax stacks; it fades by shockFadePerSecond.

lightning._note: Lightning: a kill by a shock hit (or Shock damage) jumps to the nearest enemy within range, dealing percent% more than the killing blow. If that kills, it jumps again, up to max links. 'Chain ×n' shows from showAt links; heavyAt and massiveAt play the two impact frame levels.

minis._note: There is no cap on Minis. safetyLimit only stops new ones past that many alive, to keep the frame rate up.

uncapped._note: Limits that stay after a cap Legendary removes a cap, so the physics keeps working: Speed, Spin, blades, projectiles per volley.

feel._cardTiltNote: Augment cards lift on hover and lean away under the pointer. maxDegrees is the lean, lift is in pixels, scale 1.02 = 2% bigger.
feel._typewriterNote: The recap after a fight types itself out. charsPerSecond: typing speed at 1x game speed. scaleWithSpeed: type faster at 2x, 4x and 8x. soundEvery: a click every so many letters. Any mouse click skips it. Set enabled to false to show it at once.
feel._stretchNote: Squash and stretch, drawing only. A ball faster than startSpeed stretches along its path, up to maxStretch (0.22 = 22% longer) at fullSpeed. On a bounce it squashes by up to bounceSquash for bounceSeconds. Balls slower than startSpeed stay round.

impact._note: Impact frames. When one hit deals a big share of the strongest enemy's Max HP, the fight freezes for a moment and the arena plays a style. The highest level the hit reaches is used. 'freeze' is seconds of real time. A style is a list of frames: each lasts 'ms' milliseconds and can set a CSS 'filter' on the arena, an 'overlay' color with 'overlayOpacity', a 'zoom' toward the hit, and a 'shake'. To add a look, add a style and name it in a level. minReferenceHp stops weak enemies from making every hit count as huge (it scales with the tier). No impact frames play above 'maxSpeed', or closer together than 'minSecondsBetween'. Devices set to reduce motion (an accessibility setting) get no impact frames unless respectReducedMotion is false.

admin._note: showToggle puts an Admin button in the header. Admin mode adds a panel for overriding the player's stats and triggering impact frames. Set it to false before sharing the game.

_raritiesNote: Rarities in order, lowest first. The rarity with "void": true is for Void augments: never in the shop, only from the Night Market (Crystal Ball item); they take no socket and cannot be sold. 'color' tints the augment's name and glow. 'metal' is the card body: three colors for the highlight, the main tone and the shadow of the metal. The fourth rarity always glows and the fifth also gets a sweeping shine (cards.css, classes c3 and c4).

weaponTypes._note: Physical behaviour of each blade shape, shared by the player and enemies. hitCooldown is seconds between hits from one blade.

weapons._note: The six starting weapons. 'ramp' is what the weapon gains during a fight; it resets every fight. rampText is shown to the player and reads its numbers from 'ramp'. knockback: how hard the blade pushes enemies (blank = its blade shape's knockback). impact: how hard the ball itself shoves enemies it bumps (blank = 0).

sword.name: Sword
sword.blurb: Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.blurb: High Power. Slow. Stuns on hit.

bow.name: Bow
bow.blurb: Ranged, auto-aims. Spin: fire rate. Reach: arrow speed.

augments._note: rarity must match a name in 'rarities'. tags are labels shown on the card and used for nothing else. 'values' are the numbers the augment's code reads. needs: "blade" means the shop never offers it to Bare Fists (no blade: Spin, Reach and Knockback do nothing).

rubber.name: Rubber Core
rubber.text: On bounce: next hit +{power} Power. Stacks to {max}.

pinball.name: Pinball
pinball.text: On bounce: +{speedPercent}% Speed this fight. Max +{maxPercent}%.

echo.name: Echo Chamber
echo.text: Every {every} bounces: a Shock wave for {powerPercent}% Power.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.text: On hit: +1 Power per {speedPer} current Speed.

combo.name: Combo Meter
combo.text: +{mult} Mult per hit within {window}s of the last. Resets on missed window.

parry.name: Riposte
parry.text: On parry: hits the enemy for {powerPercent}% Power.

exec.name: Executioner
exec.text: Crits kill enemies below {hpPercent}% HP. Bosses: ×{bossMult} Mult instead.

neuro.name: Neurotoxin
neuro.text: +{mult} Mult per Poison on the target.

plague.name: Plague Bearer
plague.text: On death, a poisoned enemy passes its Poison to all others.

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.text: On bounce: +{stacks} Poison to all enemies.

accel.name: Accelerant
accel.text: Burn deals +{damagePercent}% damage and fades at ×{fadeMult} speed.

flash.name: Flashpoint
flash.text: At {threshold} Burn: explodes for {powerPercent}% Power per stack. Consumes Burn.

coil.name: Static Coil
coil.text: Every {every} hits: Shock chains to {targets} enemies for {percent}% damage. No other enemy: {soloPercent}% to the same target.

capacitor.name: Capacitor
capacitor.text: On bounce: +1 Charge. Max {max}. Next hit: Shock all enemies for {powerPercent}% Power per Charge.

tesla.name: Tesla Node
tesla.text: Every {interval}s: Shock the nearest enemy for {powerPercent}% Power.

forged.name: Tempered Plate
forged.text: Fight won: +{armor} Armor. Lasts the run.

stoneheart.name: Stone Heart
stoneheart.text: +1 Armor per {hpPer} Max HP. Counts augments above.

ironclad.name: Ironclad
ironclad.text: +{power} Power per Armor. Counts augments above.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion._note: Each hit your ball takes that the Armor cap limits (Armor would block more than the cap allows): +power Power for the rest of the fight, up to max hits.
bastion.text: Each hit taken at the Armor Cap: +{power} Power this fight. Max +{maxPower}.

spike.name: Spiked Shell
spike.text: On contact: deals {hpPercent}% of Max HP.

jugg.name: Juggernaut
jugg.text: +1 Power per {hpPer} Max HP. Counts augments above.

heavy.name: Heavyweight
heavy.text: +1 Power per {hpPer} Max HP. Counts all augments.

wind.name: Second Wind
wind.text: Once per fight: survive a lethal hit at {hpPercent}% HP. Immune for {seconds}s.

bers.name: Berserker
bers.text: Up to ×{maxMult} Mult at low HP.

packquest.name: Pack Training
packquest._note: Counts Minis spawned while you own it (Mini-Yous and Hatchlings count, Afterimage clones do not). knockPercent: share of your Knockback each Mini ram uses.
packquest.text: Quest: spawn {need} Minis. Reward: Minis get your Speed and Knockback (Fists: Impact).

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.text: Every {interval}s: each Mini makes a clone for {seconds}s. Clones count as Minis.

nursery.name: Nursery
nursery.text: Each Mini that ends a won fight above {percent}% HP: +1 Mini at fight start. Max +{max}.

packbounce.name: Pack Bounce
packbounce.text: Every {interval}s, for {seconds}s: Minis' bounces count as yours.

packcontact.name: Pack Contact
packcontact.text: Every {interval}s, for {seconds}s: Minis' hits trigger your On contact effects.

packhunt.name: Pack Hunt
packhunt.text: Every {interval}s, for {seconds}s: Minis ram for {powerPercent}% Power.

lifeline.name: Lifeline
lifeline._note: sharePercent: how much of your Regen each Mini gets.
lifeline.text: +{regen} HP/s. Minis heal at your Regen too.

herd.name: Pack Armor
herd._note: sharePercent: how much of your Armor each Mini gets (without this, Minis get rules.minis.armorPercent).
herd.text: +{armor} Armor. Minis get all your Armor.

skin.name: Second Skin
skin.text: After taking damage: immune for {seconds}s. Minis too.

packtactics.name: Pack Tactics
packtactics.text: Minis' rams trigger your On hit effects.

hut.name: Mini Hut
hut._note: The Hut is a fixed ball beside you with hpPercent of your Max HP; enemies can attack it. every: seconds between Minis. keep: most Minis kept from a won fight for the next one. radius: its size.
hut.text: Fight start: a Hut that makes a Mini every {every}s until destroyed. Keeps up to {keep} surviving Minis.

fission.name: Mitosis
fission._note: (id stays 'fission'; the names of this and the Common were swapped on 16 Nov.) Your twin has your weapon and stats, its own ramp, and its own copy of every augment (and its own Minis, which die with it). Both halves have hpPercent of your Max HP. While two or more halves live, each deals damagePercent (Minis' rams are not cut). countsAs: how many Minis each other half counts as (Hive Mind, Underdog). If your ball falls while a twin lives, you carry on in the twin. Mirror Ball or Resonator on it makes more twins.
fission.text: Split in two. Each half: {hpPercent}% Max HP, {damagePercent}% damage, its own copy of your augments and Minis.

sidearm.name: Sidearm
sidearm.text: Every {interval}s: fires a pellet for {powerPercent}% Power.

rico.name: Ricochet Rounds
rico.text: Projectiles bounce {bounces} times. Each counts as a bounce.

sweetspot.name: Sweet Spot
sweetspot._note: reach: how far from your ball (in the same units as the Reach stat) a weapon hit must land.
sweetspot.text: Weapon hits {reach}+ Reach away: ×{mult} Mult. Arrows: after flying {arrowRange}.

sweep.name: Sweep
sweep.text: Your blade hits every enemy it touches, not just the first.

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.text: ×Mult grows with Reach: +{mult} per {reachPer} above your weapon's.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.text: Fight start: +{stacks} Burn to all enemies.

wallslam.name: Wall Slam
wallslam._note: window: seconds after a knock in which hitting a wall still counts.
wallslam.text: Enemies you knock into a wall take {percent}% Power.

chainrx.name: Chain Reaction
chainrx._note: minImpact: closing speed two enemies need. cooldown: seconds before the same enemy can be hit this way again.
chainrx.text: Enemies that collide at speed both take {percent}% Power.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.text: Enemies near you drift toward you.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: Hit on a Frozen enemy: ×{mult} Mult. Ends the Freeze.

thermal.name: Thermal Shock
thermal.text: Burn on a Chilled enemy: consumes both for {percent}% Power per stack.

fuel.name: Fuel
fuel.text: +{mult} Mult per Burn on the target.

afterburner.name: Afterburner
afterburner.text: On bounce: +{stacks} Burn to the nearest enemy.

tagteam.name: Tag Team
tagteam.text: +{percent}% damage per different tag among your augments.

specialist.name: Specialist
specialist.text: +{percent}% damage per augment sharing your most common tag.

breakshot.name: Break Shot
breakshot.text: Collisions deal {percent}% Power per 100 Speed of impact.

velocity.name: Velocity
velocity.text: +1 Power per {speedPer} Speed. Counts augments above.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.text: Burning enemies pass {percent}% of their Burn to enemies they touch.

maw.name: Maw
maw._note: perEat: ×Mult gained per augment eaten (any rarity; a Maw eaten by a Maw also hands over what it stored). max: the most it can store; once full it stops eating. The ×Mult is 1 + what it has stored, so max 5 = ×6.
maw.text: Fight start: eats the augment below for +{perEat} ×Mult. Full at +{max}: stops eating.

followthrough.name: Follow-Through
followthrough.text: Hits on enemies knocked in the last {window}s: +{mult} Mult.

wrecking.name: Wrecking Ball
wrecking.text: Per {hpPer} Max HP: +{percent}% Knockback, +{impact} Impact. Counts augments above.

quake.name: Earthquake
quake._note: every: bounces between quakes. percent: share of Power dealt to every enemy. stunSeconds: how long enemies are stunned (bosses 40% of that). shake: screen shake.
quake.text: Every {every} bounces: Shock all enemies for {percent}% Power. Stuns them briefly.

cradle.name: Newton's Cradle
cradle._note: window: seconds a knocked enemy stays 'moving'. knockPercent: share of your Knockback passed on. cooldown: per enemy. showAt: chain length from which 'Chain ×n' shows. heavyAt and massiveAt: chain lengths that play the two impact frame levels.
cradle.text: Knocked enemies pass the knock to enemies they hit, for {percent}% Power. Chains.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.text: Burn no longer fades. Burn grows {percent}% per second.

terminal.name: Terminal Velocity
terminal.text: ×Mult grows with Speed: +{mult} per {speedPer} above your weapon's.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.text: ×Mult grows with Max HP: +{mult} per {hpPer} Max HP.

overclock.name: Overclock
overclock.text: +{mult} Mult per 10% Overflow on Speed, Spin and Blades.

ambi.name: Ambidextrous
ambi._note: A bonus weapon: more weapons on your ball than your weapon starts with (Twin Daggers start with 2, so they need a third).
ambi.text: ×{mult} Mult while you carry a bonus weapon.

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.text: ×{mult} Mult per 10 of your most frequent event this fight.

uncapspd.name: Escape Velocity
uncapspd._note: Cap Legendaries: the cap is gone while you own one; selling it brings the cap back. rules.uncapped holds the physics limits that stay.

uncaparmor.name: Adamant
uncaparmor.text: Removes the Armor cap. Hits still deal at least 1.

minime.name: Mini Me
minime._note: A Mini that stays alive for 'seconds' in a fight becomes a Mini-You there and then (up to max at once). hpPercent: a Mini-You's HP as a share of your Max HP. reachPercent: its blade length as a share of yours. miniDamagePercent: how hard ordinary Minis ram while you hold this (100 = unchanged; lower it to nerf them before they transform).
minime.text: Minis: -{hpCut}% Max HP. A Mini alive for {seconds}s becomes a Mini-You: your weapon and augments, {damagePercent}% damage. Max {max}.

domino.name: Domino Effect
domino._note: A projectile that kills an enemy flies on to the nearest one with percent% more damage, up to max links. showAt: chain length from which 'Chain ×n' shows. heavyAt and massiveAt: chain lengths that play the two impact frame levels. The card keeps the run's longest chain.
domino.text: Projectile kills: it flies on to the nearest enemy with +{percent}% damage. Chains.

seep.name: Seeping Wounds
seep._note: Poison and Burn ticks are multiplied by your current Mult on that enemy (what a hit on it would get, crits aside). percent: how much of the Mult above ×1 counts (100 = all of it).
seep.text: Poison and Burn ticks are multiplied by your Mult.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.text: Poison and Burn deal ×{mult} damage. ×{bothMult} with both.

converge.name: Convergence
converge._note: Counts the statuses your side has applied this fight: Burn, Chill (or Freeze), Poison, Shock. per: ×Mult added for each, so all four = ×5.
converge.text: +{per} ×Mult for each Status you've applied this fight.

retrib.name: Retribution
retrib._note: When an enemy hits your ball, the damage your Armor blocked (the hit before Armor minus what you took) is dealt back to that enemy, times percent and your Mult on it (what a hit on it would get, crits aside). Its Armor still applies.
retrib.text: Damage your Armor blocks is reflected to the attacker at {percent}%, multiplied by your Mult.

vhands.name: Empty Hands
vhands._note: No weapon (Bare Fists: no body-hit damage) and no On hit effects, except on slams: an enemy you knocked that hits a wall or another enemy within window seconds takes percent% Power × Mult as a hit with On hit effects (each enemy once per cooldown). Contacts push with Impact + Knockback.
vhands.text: No weapon and no On hit effects. +{impact} Impact. Enemies you knock into walls or each other take {percent}% Power, with On hit effects.

vglut.name: Gluttony
vglut._note: Kills over the run grow you: +size% Size and -speed% Speed each, up to sizeMax and speedMax. Max HP cut to hpPercent. ×Mult +mult for every 10% Size above normal, from any source.
vglut.text: Max HP cut to {hpPercent}%. On kill: +{size}% Size, -{speed}% Speed, up to +{sizeMax}% and -{speedMax}%. ×Mult +{mult} per 10% Size above normal.

vpull.name: Event Horizon
vpull.text: Enemies are pulled toward you all fight. ×{mult} Mult.

vecho.name: Echoing Void
vecho.text: Sockets {cut}+ are switched off. Sockets 1 to {keep} trigger {times} times.

vbleed.name: Bleeding Edge
vbleed.text: Lose {drain}% Max HP per second. Each hit this fight: +{mult} ×Mult.

mass.name: Critical Mass
mass.text: +{percent}% Crit per hit this fight. Crit above 100% adds Crit damage.

consumables._note: One-fight items. Bought in the shop into your bag, switched on before a fight with a click, used up when that fight starts. Right-click one in the bag to sell it for half. needs: "blade" means Bare Fists are never offered it. Adding an item also needs code (core.js ITEM_CODE).

padlock.name: Padlock
padlock.text: Your sockets can't be switched off or eaten.

crystal.name: Crystal Ball
crystal.text: Click in your bag: opens the Night Market. Choose 1 of {offers} Void augments.

smoke.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke.text: Fight start: Freezes every enemy for {seconds}s.

rampoil.name: Ramp Oil
rampoil._note: Adds these flat amounts to each step of your weapon's Ramp (only the parts your weapon's Ramp has): power and mult per hit, spinPercent per hit, reach per hit, hitsPerArrow is taken off the hits needed per arrow, speedPercentPerBounce per bounce. The shop hint shows the result for your weapon.

tuneUps._note: Permanent stat upgrades sold in the shop. The eleven ids hp to mini are fixed. 'amount' is what one purchase adds. Optional 'weight' sets how often it shows up in the shop (1 = normal, 0.35 = about a third as often). needs: "blade" means Bare Fists never see it; "ranged" means only the Bow, or a run that owns Sidearm or Multishot, sees it. 'color' tints the shop box and the name. 'stat' is the word in 'text' that gets a hover hint and 'tip' is that hint (stats that are glossary keywords, like Power, use the glossary line instead).
tuneUps._bladeNote: blade (optional id): +amount weapons per purchase (never offered to Bare Fists). Optional costStep on any tune-up replaces rules.economy.tuneUpCostStep for it.
tuneUps._capNote: Cap tune-ups: any other id with "cap" (spd, spin, blades, volley or armor) raises that cap by 'amount' per purchase for the rest of the run. Optional 'cost' is its starting price (tuneUpCostStep still adds on per purchase). Not offered once a cap Legendary has removed that cap. Armor's cap never goes past 95%.

hp.name: Padding
hp.tip: How much damage your ball can take before it falls.

spin.name: Grease
spin.tip: How fast your blade turns. On the Bow: fire rate.

regen.name: Patch Kit
regen.tip: Max HP your ball regains every second.

blade.name: Spare Blade
blade.tip: Another copy of your weapon on your ball. Blades has a cap.

size.name: Bulk
size.tip: How big your ball is. Bigger balls are harder to push and easier to hit.

capspd.name: Tailwind
capspd.tip: Raises the Speed cap: the most your Speed can be. Past a cap the extra is overflow.

capspin.name: Ball Bearing
capspin.tip: Raises the Spin cap: the most your Spin can be. Past a cap the extra is overflow.

capblades.name: Weapon Rack
capblades.tip: Raises the blade cap: the most blades you can carry. Past a cap the extra is overflow.

capvolley.name: Big Quiver
capvolley.tip: Raises the Volley cap: the most projectiles in one volley.

caparmor.name: Rivets
caparmor.tip: Raises the most of each hit Armor can block.

trophies._note: Boss rewards. The player picks 1 of 3 after each boss. Optional 'weight' sets how often one is offered (1 = normal, 1.5 = half again as often).

coupon.name: Coupon Book
coupon.text: Augments cost ${discount} less. Rerolls start at ${rerollBase}.

taste.name: Rare Taste
taste.text: Rare, Epic and Legendary augments appear ×{mult} as often.

pack.name: Pack Leader
pack.text: Fight start: +{count} Minis. Minis deal +{percent}% damage.

enemies._note: cost is how much of a fight's budget one of these uses. minTier is the first tier it can appear in. hp and damage numbers are tier 1 values and scale up. A weapon is { type, power, reach, spin }. Optional abilities: pack (comes in groups), bombDamage + bombRadius (explodes on death), splitsInto + splitCount, healPerSecond. 'about' is the hint shown on the fight preview. 'values' are the numbers its behaviour reads (core.js ENEMY_CODE). Every attack has a visible wind-up.

grunt.name: Grunt
grunt.aboutEndless: Rams you along a marked path.

stabber.name: Stabber
stabber.about: Sidesteps your blade. Outlined when ready.

lancer.name: Lancer
lancer.about: Spear aimed at you glows and hits double.

brute.name: Brute
brute.about: Stamps, then charges. Stunned if it hits a wall.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.about: Lights a fuse near you. The blast hurts enemies too.

medic.name: Medic
medic.about: Heals with a beam. Cut it with your blade.

guard.name: Guard
guard.about: Rushes to shield hurt allies from you.

crusher.name: Crusher
crusher.about: Slams the floor around it. Leave the ring.

pool.name: Pool Ball
pool.about: The Eight Ball's balls. Big ones ram along a marked path.
pool._note: Only The Eight Ball's racks (minTier 99 keeps it out of normal fights). All the same size and HP (tier scaling on top); big ones have bigRadiusX size and bigHpX HP and ram. Bumping your ball shoves it with solidImpact (1 to 7) or stripeImpact (9 to 15). Rams: every ramEvery seconds (first one after 0.5 to 1.5 times that) it stands still for ramWindup showing its path (ramBounces wall bounces), then charges at ramSpeed; a hit deals ramDamageMult x body damage and knocks with ramKnock. Ends after ramMaxSeconds. Rack: spacing, apex at rackX of the arena width, still for rackPause seconds. Grunts in endless mode ram with these numbers too, but every gruntRamEvery seconds and with gruntRamDamageMult.

bosses._note: Same stat fields as enemies, plus 'rule' (shown to the player), 'phase2' (what changes at half HP), 'weak' and 'resists' (keywords shown on the boss card) and 'values' (numbers the boss's special behaviour reads). hp is multiplied by rules.scaling.bossHpFactor. A boss added here with no code is simply a big enemy with these stats. Optional minTier: the boss never comes before that tier.

bulwark.name: The Bulwark
bulwark.rule: Heavy Armor. Crits and wall slams crack it: -{crack} Armor.
bulwark.phase2: Raises a front shield for {shieldSeconds}s every {shieldEvery}s.

hydra.name: The Hydra
hydra.rule: Splits in {children} on death, {generations} times. Heads that touch merge back.

reflect.name: The Reflection
reflect.rule: Copies your weapon and takes your top augment: +{perRarityPercent}% damage per rarity.
reflect.phase2: Gives it back and takes your second augment. At 25%: your third.

magnet.name: The Magnet
magnet.rule: Pulls your ball in, harder up close. High body damage.
magnet.phase2: Flips every {flipEvery}s: pushes you away and pulls its allies in.

nullb.name: The Null
nullb.rule: Switches off one socket. Moves down one every {moveEvery}s.
nullb.phase2: Switches off two sockets at once.

glacier.name: The Glacier
glacier.rule: Immune to Chill. Your bounces: -{slowPercent}% Speed and Spin.
glacier.phase2: Leaves ice where it bounces. Ice Freezes your ball.

queen.name: The Brood Queen
queen.rule: Spawns Swarmlings. Swarmlings alive {growAfter}s grow into Grunts.
queen.phase2: Spawns twice as fast. Takes +{frenzyTakenPercent}% damage while a Swarmling lives.

furnace.name: The Furnace
furnace.rule: Immune to Burn. Your bounces cost {hpPercent}% Max HP.
furnace.phase2: Two walls glow. Bouncing on one costs ×{hotMult}.

storm.name: The Storm
storm.rule: Strikes marked spots from the sky. Each Shock hit it takes adds a strike.

gavel.name: The Gavel
gavel.rule: Huge Knockback. Slammed into a wall: -{hpPercent}% Max HP.
gavel.phase2: Leaps and slams every {slamEvery}s, knocking every ball away.
gavel._note: knockMult multiplies its hammer's knockback. window: seconds after a blow in which your wall bounce counts as a slam. Max HP and size resist the knockback.

eight.name: The Eight Ball
eight.rule: Invulnerable while its balls are alive. Knock balls into the pockets to execute them, but don't get knocked in yourself.
eight.phase2: Faster, and resists your most used damage type by {resistPercent}%.
eight._note: rack 1: it starts with the 7 solids (enemies.pool) and is invulnerable while any of its balls lives. Solids cleared: it loses clearPercent of its Max HP (never dies from it) and the 7 stripes arrive, bigCount of them big and ramming. Then it is alone. Pockets: an enemy knocked in within pocketWindow dies; the Eight Ball itself only when alone, for bossPercent of its Max HP (never kills), then not again for bossCooldown seconds. Your ball knocked in: speed 0 for stallSeconds, back to full over climbSeconds.

text._note: Interface wording. Placeholders here are filled by the game: {tier}, {tiers}, {gold}, {per}, {cap}, {now}, {boss}, {used}, {slots}, {mult}, {percent}, {hp}, {name}, {value}. Set colorKeywords to false to stop coloring words like Power and Mult on cards.
text.howBody: Damage = Power × Mult. Augments trigger top to bottom: +Mult before ×Mult. Ramp builds during a fight, then resets.
text.sellBinTip: Drag an augment here to sell
text.bagHint: Single Use: click to activate at the start of the next fight.
text.lightAutoSimple: Frames were slow, so lighting switched to Simple. Change it with the Lighting button.
text.crystalUse: Click: open the Night Market now.
text.breakdownAddedTip: Extra damage each one added on top of the hits it boosted. Boosts overlap, so these can add up to more than the total.
text.consumableTip: Single Use: click to activate at the start of the next fight.
text.tagTip: Tags: the families this augment belongs to.
text.capTip: Cap: the most this stat can be. Past it the extra is overflow.
text.condNote: (+{v}): extra when its conditional bonuses apply.
text.fistSpeedNote: body hits, from Speed above base
text.multOrder: +Mult adds first, then ×Mult multiplies, top socket to bottom.
text.hitTip: Power × Mult: what one hit deals before Crits and enemy Armor.

condReasons.atArmorCap: hits taken at the Armor Cap
condReasons.mawEats: eats the augment below at fight start
condReasons.topEvent: grows with your most frequent event
condReasons.farHits: weapon hits far from your ball

text.armorCapTip: Armor: flat damage taken off every hit you take. It never takes off more than {cap}% of one hit.
text.rampTip: Your {weapon}: {ramp}. Gained during a fight, reset after it.
text.multTip: In a fight: the Mult your next hit gets right now, in socket order, against the nearest enemy. Crits not counted. In the shop: the Mult that applies to every hit.

_eventHintsNote: Hover hints for trigger words at the start of card text. The keys are matched as written; 'Every' covers 'Every 3 hits:', 'Every 1.5s:' and the like.

eventHints.On hit: Each time one of your hits lands: weapon, body, projectile or effect.
eventHints.On bounce: Each time your ball hits a wall.
eventHints.On contact: Each time your ball touches an enemy.
eventHints.On parry: Each time your blade clashes with an enemy blade.
eventHints.On Crit: Each time you land a critical hit.
eventHints.After taking damage: Each time your ball is hurt.
eventHints.Every: Counts up during the fight and fires each time the count is reached.
eventHints.tag: Tags are the families on each card (bounce, blade, swarm...).

keywords._note: Short definitions shown in the Rules card on the title screen and as hover hints on cards. One line each. Remove an entry to drop it from the glossary.
keywords.Power: Damage of a hit before Mult.
keywords.Ramp: Weapon bonus gained during a fight.
keywords.Burn: {burnDps} damage/s per stack, +{burnPower}% of Power. Fades.
keywords.Chill: -{chillSlow}% Speed and Spin per stack. Fades. At {chillMax}: Frozen.
keywords.Frozen: Can't move or attack for {freezeSeconds}s. Bosses: half as long.
keywords.Knockback: How far your hits push enemies. Max HP resists it.
keywords.Impact: How hard your ball shoves enemies it bumps.
keywords.Quest: A goal. Once done, its reward lasts the rest of the run.
keywords.Collision: Two balls bumping. Yours, enemies and Minis all count.
keywords.Armor: Flat damage blocked per hit. Max {armorCap}%.
keywords.Mini: Small ally. Rams for {miniPower}% Power, without your On hit effects.
keywords.Shock: Each stack: that enemy deals -{shockPct}% damage. Max {shockMax}. Fades.
keywords.Lightning: A Shock kill jumps to the nearest enemy for +{lightningPct}% damage. Chains.
keywords.Status: Burn, Chill, Poison or Shock on an enemy.
keywords.Cap: The most a stat can be. Shown next to it, like /760.
keywords.Overflow: The part of a stat above its cap. Kept, not lost: it does nothing by itself.
keywords.Void: An augment from the Night Market. Takes no socket. Can't be sold.

theme._note: Colors are hex codes. Fonts: 'display' and 'body' are family names. The files are in assets.fonts; a Google Fonts family also works if googleFontsUrl is its stylesheet link (leave it empty otherwise).

fonts._sizeNote: Both fonts are pixel fonts, sharp only at set sizes. displaySize is the title size in px: Pixel Game is sharp at 32.68 (smaller, its letters blur: G reads as B). bodySize is the size of all small text, card names included: Alpha Beta is sharp at 13.333 or 26.667. displayScale sizes the numbers drawn in the arena. displayMetrics centres Pixel Game in its line.

theme._poolBallsNote: Colours of pool balls 1 to 7; 9 to 15 are the same colours as stripes.
theme._lightingNote: Lighting. mode: 'full' (lights from the fight) or 'simple' (only the mouse light); players can switch it with the Lighting button. ambient: how dark the arena always is (0 = not at all). maxDim: the darkest lightning can make it. autoSimpleMs: if a frame takes longer than this for 3 seconds in full mode, the game switches to simple once. flashes: short lights from events (lightning = strikes from the sky, spark = other zaps, blast = big rings and explosions, glint = small rings, quake, impact = impact frames): color, intensity, radius (how far it reaches), height (lower = longer shadows), life in seconds, dim (how much it darkens everything else). glows: lights that follow things while they last (burning balls, frozen balls, warning marks). bossGlow: a boss that gives off light.
theme._pixelPanelsNote: pixelPanels: cards, sheets, stat cells, readout bubbles and shop boxes get pixel-art frames drawn in the page colours (false = the old rounded look).
theme._ballLookNote: How balls are drawn. shading: three tones stepped toward the light plus a highlight. shadow: a shadow on the floor; shadowLength: how far it reaches past the ball (share of the ball's radius). stripe: a light band that rolls as the ball moves. mouseLight: the light follows the mouse (otherwise it stays top left). lightEase: how quickly the light catches up with the mouse (lower is smoother). lightHeight: how high above the table the light hangs (higher is softer when the mouse is over a ball). weaponShadow and weaponShadowOffset: weapons cast a shadow too. weaponLight: how much brighter a weapon gets when it points toward the light. pixelArt and pixel: draw shading, highlights, outlines, shadows and light pools as chunky pixels, one pixel per 'pixel' arena units (false = smooth). Opacities are 0 to 1. A ball with its own sprite only gets the shadow.

assets._note: Every slot is null, which means 'draw it with code'. To use your own file, put its path here, for example "assets/player.png". Images: PNG, WebP or SVG. Sounds: MP3, OGG or WAV. See the handoff guide for sizes and which way sprites should face.
assets._cardFrameLayoutNote: Measurements of the card frame pictures, in picture pixels (the shipped frames are 456 x 192: pixel art 76 x 32, saved 6x). The card is shown 96 px tall, so every number is scaled by 96 / pictureHeight. sliceLeft and sliceRight: the parts that never stretch (the middle stretches to the card's width). artX, artY, artSize: the art circle's top-left corner and diameter. plateLeft and plateTop: where the text area starts and how far it sits in from the top and bottom. endCenter: distance from the right edge to the centre of the right round end, where the Buy button sits.
assets._fontsNote: Font files for theme.fonts.display and theme.fonts.body. Pixel Game is free for personal use only (1001fonts licence): a game that earns money needs the author's permission. Alpha Beta (Brian Kent) is freeware. Neither file may be altered.

cardFrames._note: Picture of the whole card body, one per rarity name: frame, text plate and the socket for the art circle. Its measurements are in assets.cardFrameLayout. Set one to null to fall back to the built-in CSS metal.

sellBin._note: The needle that augments are dragged onto to sell them. 256 x 256, transparent. 'armed' shows while an augment is held over it; leave it null to use 'idle' for both.

icons._note: Small pictures shown on cards. Add any augment, weapon, tune-up or trophy id, for example "whet": "assets/icons/whet.png".
